apps.localizedDescription:
Minimalist, fast, tactile espresso and pour over logging app designed specifically for specialty coffee dial-in, flat-burr grinders (e.g., Timemore Sculptor 078s), and dual-boiler/profiling setups (e.g., La Marzocco Linea Micra).

Features:
• Select Espresso or Pour Over per dose (both deduct from your active bag's remaining weight)
• Dedicated Pour Over tracking: Dripper, Water Weight, Drawdown Time, Bloom Water/Wait, Pour Pulses, Agitation, and Bed Diagnostics
• Automatic pre-fill of all parameters from previous brew of that method
• Positive-only grind setting (0.0 to 16.0) with integer 0-point offset field
• Live rest day calculation (pauses calculation when frozen)
• Full Flow/Bed Quality × Sensory Balance extraction insights engine
